findings.detail: FEC Schedule B disbursements from Save America (C00762591) to PARLATORE LAW GROUP LLP, all coded 'LEGAL CONSULTING'. First disbursement: 2022-04-22 ($25,000). Last disbursement: 2023-03-22 ($50,000). Cross-PAC scan of all FEC schedule_b records confirms Save America is the ONLY Trump-aligned committee that has paid PLG -- MAGA Inc (C00825851), Trump 47 (C00867937), Trump Save America JFC (C00770941), Never Surrender Inc (C00828541), and RNC (C00003418) all show 0 disbursements to Parlatore. Paginated full-disbursement scan of Save America from 2023-04-01 onward (2000 records pulled) confirms no PLG payments after 2023-03-22, contradicting the Wave-1 working hypothesis that PLG continued to receive Save America payments after Parlatore's May 2023 departure from Trump's legal team. Disbursement totals: 2022 calendar year: $196,493.14 (5 disbursements); 2023 calendar year: $136,325.10 (4 disbursements through March 22).

findings.summary: TEMPORAL: Save America→PLG payment escalation aligned with Jack Smith Special Counsel appointment (5-day delta). Largest single PLG disbursement ($76,984.34, 2022-11-23) lands 5 days after Jack Smith was named Special Counsel (2022-11-18). Suggests retainer/legal-fee acceleration in response to escalating federal exposure, not coincidence.
findings.detail: FACT: Save America PAC paid PLG $76,984.34 on 2022-11-23 — its largest single disbursement to PLG. This is 5 calendar days after AG Garland appointed Jack Smith Special Counsel (2022-11-18) for the Mar-a-Lago documents and Jan 6 cases. Context: PLG had been on retainer since at least 2022-04-22 ($25K), and Parlatore had joined Trump's classified-documents legal team in October 2022. THEORY (synthesis): the spike size and timing are consistent with an emergency retainer top-up triggered by Special Counsel escalation, not a routine bill. Best innocent explanation: invoice accumulation from intensifying Mar-a-Lago discovery work happened to fall in that pay period. FALSIFICATION: PLG invoice copies (subpoenable) showing pre-Nov 18 work justifying $76,984 in November billings would defeat the suggestion of post-Smith trigger.

findings.summary: TEMPORAL: Save America→PLG payment stream stops 8 days before Bragg Trump indictment. Last Save America→PLG payment ($50K) on 2023-03-22; NY DA Bragg indicts Trump on 2023-03-30. Cessation pattern, not buildup, ahead of indictment.
findings.detail: FACT: 2023-03-22 was the final Save America→PLG disbursement; 2023-03-30 (8 days later) Bragg returned the Manhattan indictment. Parlatore did not represent Trump in the Bragg case, and would publicly resign from Trump legal team eight weeks later (2023-05-19), citing Boris Epshteyn obstruction. THEORY (synthesis): the cessation may reflect a deliberate decision to stop PAC-funded payments to PLG before the first criminal indictment to limit campaign-finance exposure, OR a routine end-of-engagement billing. INNOCENT EXPLANATION: PLG's classified-documents work for Trump was wrapping up regardless. FALSIFICATION: if PLG continued to be paid via OTHER Trump-aligned entities (MAGA Inc, Trump 47, RNC, JFCs) through April 2023 at similar volume, the 'stopped before Bragg' framing collapses.

findings.summary: TEMPORAL: Indyke joins PLG (~Oct 2022) within ~14 days of Parlatore joining Trump classified-documents team (2022-10-01); USVI Epstein-estate settlement follows ~Nov 2022. Three Epstein-adjacent + Trump-adjacent corporate moves in same month.
findings.detail: FACT: October 2022 brackets three notable events: (a) ~2022-10-01 Parlatore publicly disclosed as Trump classified-documents counsel; (b) ~2022-10-15 Darren Indyke (former Epstein personal/estate counsel) joins PLG as Of Counsel; (c) ~2022-11-01 USVI Epstein-estate settlement closes. THEORY (synthesis): the simultaneous arrival of an Epstein-estate insider at the firm now retained by a former Trump president — at exactly the moment the Mar-a-Lago documents matter is escalating to grand jury — is structurally noteworthy. INNOCENT EXPLANATION: Indyke had been operating his own PLLC and the move to a high-profile boutique was career-natural; PLG was rapidly hiring during Trump-engagement growth. FALSIFICATION: PLG hiring records (registry filings, malpractice carrier listings, NY State Bar registration changes) showing Indyke's joining was negotiated months earlier (e.g., spring 2022 before Mar-a-Lago raid) would defeat the 'simultaneous escalation' framing.

findings.summary: TEMPORAL: William Brown's $3,019.96 single-day Trump JFC giving (2024-10-07) lands 7 days after Rowden v. Navy active filing (2024-09-30). Maximal personal Trump-PAC contribution by a PLG partner during a window when PLG is actively suing the Navy — one month before Hegseth nomination.
findings.detail: FACT: 2024-09-30 Rowden v. Navy is on the active docket (Parlatore sole counsel for plaintiff in DDC 1:24-cv-02393); 2024-10-07 PLG partner William Brown Jr (Navy SEAL veteran) splits a single-day $3,019.96 across WinRed/Trump National JFC; 2024-11-12 Trump nominates Hegseth for SecDef. THEORY (synthesis): the timing is consistent with PLG firm-internal political alignment ahead of expected Hegseth nomination, while Parlatore is simultaneously litigating against the very service Hegseth would soon lead. INNOCENT EXPLANATION: Brown is a self-described Navy SEAL veteran with prior Republican giving; $3K-day giving is common in late-October before federal elections. FALSIFICATION: if Brown made similar single-day max giving in non-election Octobers (2022, 2026), the 2024 spike loses signal.
